title: Complete authentication and session security checks
description: Verify login, refresh, logout, cookie, session expiry, password hashing, and protected-route behavior against the PRD and preserve existing user changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Protected routes reject missing/invalid/expired sessions and refresh failures do not create a valid session
Password hashing and dummy-hash verification are safe and do not leak whether an account exists in a distinguishable way to unauthorized callers
Access/refresh cookie attributes and TTLs are explicit for local HTTP and trusted HTTPS proxy setups
Auth errors/logs/responses contain no password, token, cookie, or database secret
Tests cover login success/failure, refresh rotation/expiry, logout, proxy headers, and protected API access

steps.details: Cover missing/expired/invalid sessions, refresh rotation, logout, cookie flags, and safe dummy verification before production changes.

steps.description: Read `apps/web/src/lib/auth.ts`, JWT/session helpers, login/refresh/logout/me routes, proxy headers, and current tests; map cookie and TTL behavior.

steps.details: Correct only evidence-backed security behavior while preserving the current local/proxy deployment contract and user changes.
Run focused auth tests, origin/CSRF tests, custom harness, typecheck, lint, and a disposable local HTTP smoke test.

technicalNotes: `XT_TRUST_PROXY` must remain opt-in; never trust forwarded headers by default.
